from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the other provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all provided papers for citation analysis."""
    papers: list[Paper]
